scenarios.description: Operator invokes skill with workspace + time-range selected but no hypothesis — skill must ask for 1-3 expectations before any Phase 2 data pull. No Phase 2 tool call fires until operator submits.
assertions: first_response contains one of: 'hypothesis', 'expect', 'expectation'
first_response uses AskUserQuestion or equivalent prompt mechanism
first_tool_calls does NOT contain any of: list_workspace_stats, list_campaigns, get_campaign_stats, get_leads_analytics, list_sender_emails, get_replies_analytics
no Phase 2 data-collection tool fires until operator submits at least one hypothesis
if operator explicitly declines hypothesis, skill refuses to continue (no Phase 2 tool calls ever) per §8 skill-specific hard failure

scenarios.description: Phase 2 pull returns 300 sent over 3 days — every verdict in §6 §2 Segment Performance Ranking must auto-map to TEST MORE regardless of metric values.

operator_hypotheses: Google senders will beat Microsoft on Reply Rate by 1.5x

assertions: every row in output.section_2.ranked_rows has verdict == 'TEST MORE'
output.section_1.quick_health_check contains one of: 'sub-floor', 'below floor', '500 sent', '7 days'
zero occurrences of verdicts 'SCALE', 'TOP PERFORMER', 'MONITOR', 'UNDERPERFORM' in output.section_2.ranked_rows
report header or §6 §1 explicitly references the statistical-significance floor

scenarios.description: Draft §6 §2 contains subjective phrasing ('solid performance, keep running') — skill must self-correct to a §3.5 verdict label before report write.

input.operator_draft_row: Campaign Denver-Parks: solid performance, keep running

assertions: every row in output.section_2.ranked_rows contains exactly one of the five §3.5 labels: 'TOP PERFORMER', 'SCALE', 'TEST MORE', 'MONITOR', 'UNDERPERFORM'
output.section_2 contains zero instances of: 'solid', 'okay', 'meh', 'pretty good', 'needs work', 'strong', 'weak'
every row in output.section_5.attribution_rows carries a §3.5 verdict label

scenarios.description: After successful Procedure 1 Phase 4, skill must deliver the verbatim BC-5830 handoff clause before exiting. Run does not count as complete until operator confirms.

operator_hypotheses: Google senders will beat Microsoft by 1.5x

assertions: final_response contains the exact string: 'Analysis complete. To capture these learnings so they compound into future campaigns, run the campaign debrief workflow.'
final_response references 'BC-5830' OR 'campaign-debrief'
skill does not mark run complete until operator confirms handoff

scenarios.description: Phase 3 finding spans Timing + Segment ('low replies on Fridays from senior titles') — §6 §5 Attribution Analysis must render two separate rows, one per variable, not one combined row.

input.phase3_finding: low replies on Fridays from senior titles

assertions: output.section_5.attribution_rows contains at least 2 rows derived from this finding
one row attributes to §3.1 Core Variable 'Timing' (Friday send day)
one row attributes to §3.1 Core Variable 'Segment' (senior titles)
no single row in output.section_5 attributes to 2+ Core Variables
each of the two rows carries its own §3.5 verdict label

scenarios.description: Operator asks for a non-existent EB tool name (e.g. list_campaigns_by_date) — skill must refuse and point to list_campaigns + client-side filter per §4.1 + email-bison.md §Known gotchas.

input.operator_request: use list_campaigns_by_date to filter by date range

assertions: skill response references 'list_campaigns' (the correct tool)
skill response references one of: 'client-side filter', 'client-side', 'no server-side date filter', 'email-bison.md'
no call_api tool call with the fabricated name 'list_campaigns_by_date'
no MCP tool call to any tool not listed in §5 MCP Tool Reference

scenarios.description: docs/marketing-context.md specifies primary_entity=brite-supply — skill routes to emailbison-b2b workspace and applies §3.3 b2b benchmarks. Absent-file variant triggers BC-5824 precedent warning.
assertions: variant[present]: Read tool call fires on 'docs/marketing-context.md' during Gate 1
variant[present]: skill picks workspace == 'emailbison-b2b' (not 'emailbison-personal')
variant[present]: skill applies §3.3 b2b benchmark table (Reply > 1% Healthy / Interested > 25% / Bounce < 3%)
variant[present]: output.section_1.quick_health_check does NOT contain 'b2c benchmarks uncalibrated' footer
variant[present]: no §4 b2c benchmark thresholds applied
variant[absent]: first_response contains BC-5824 precedent warning message
variant[absent]: first_response contains AskUserQuestion entity prompt
variant[absent]: no workspace selected until operator answers the entity question

scenarios.description: Procedure 1 invocation — first MCP call must be get_active_workspace_info before any data-collection tool. Mismatch between probe result and Gate 2 choice stops the run.

operator_hypotheses: Google senders will beat Microsoft by 1.5x

assertions: first EB MCP call is get_active_workspace_info on the Gate-2-detected workspace
no call to list_workspace_stats, list_campaigns, get_campaign_stats, get_leads_analytics, list_sender_emails, or get_replies_analytics fires before get_active_workspace_info
variant[match]: skill proceeds to §5 Phase 2 step 2 (list_workspace_stats)
variant[mismatch]: skill stops and reports the mismatch to operator
variant[mismatch]: no further EB tool calls fire after the mismatch is detected
variant[mismatch]: skill does NOT call set_active_workspace to fix the mismatch (Procedure 1 step 1 explicitly bans this)
